fragment:
<set-variable name="ru-int-base-url" value="@{
        var raw = Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-base-url", "https://randomuser.me/api/"));
        raw = (raw ?? "").Trim();
        return raw.EndsWith("/") ? raw : raw + "/";
    }" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-results-raw" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-results", "10")).Trim())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-page-raw" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-page", "1")).Trim())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-seed" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-seed", "")).Trim())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-gender" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-gender", "")).Trim().ToLowerInvariant())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-nationalities" value="@{
        var csv = Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-nationalities", ""));
        return string.Join(",", (csv ?? "")
            .Split(new[] { ',', ';', ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
            .Select(n => n.Trim().ToUpperInvariant())
            .Distinct());
    }" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-include-fields" value="@{
        var csv = Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-include-fields", ""));
        return string.Join(",", (csv ?? "")
            .Split(new[] { ',', ';', ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
            .Select(f => f.Trim().ToLowerInvariant())
            .Distinct());
    }" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-min-age-raw" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-min-age", "0")).Trim())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-max-age-raw" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-max-age", "120")).Trim())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-sort-by" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-sort-by", "none")).Trim().ToLowerInvariant())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-sort-direction" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-sort-direction", "asc")).Trim().ToLowerInvariant())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-take-raw" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-take", "0")).Trim())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-timeout-raw" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-timeout-seconds", "10")).Trim())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-cache-raw" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-cache-seconds", "0")).Trim())" />
    <set-variable name="ru-int-fail-mode" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-fail-mode", "soft")).Trim().ToLowerInvariant())" />
    
    
    
    
    <set-variable name="ru-int-errors" value="@{
        var errors = new JArray();
        // a local function: Func<> and the other delegate types are not on the gateway allowlist
        int? parseRange(string name, string raw, int min, int max) {
            int parsed;
            if (!int.TryParse(raw, out parsed)) {
                errors.Add($"{name} must be an integer, got \"{raw}\"");
                return null;
            }
            if (parsed < min || parsed > max) {
                errors.Add($"{name} must be between {min} and {max}, got {parsed}");
                return null;
            }
            return parsed;
        }

        // base url: https, randomuser.me only, no query string smuggling
        // new Uri(string) only accepts absolute URLs; Uri.TryCreate needs UriKind, which the gateway rejects at save
        Uri baseUri = null;
        var baseUrl = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-base-url"];
        try { baseUri = new Uri(baseUrl); } catch (Exception) { }
        if (baseUri == null) {
            errors.Add($"ru-arg-base-url is not an absolute URL: \"{baseUrl}\"");
        } else {
            if (baseUri.Scheme != "https") { errors.Add("ru-arg-base-url must use https"); }
            if (baseUri.Host != "randomuser.me" && !baseUri.Host.EndsWith(".randomuser.me")) {
                errors.Add($"ru-arg-base-url host must be randomuser.me, got {baseUri.Host}");
            }
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(baseUri.Query) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(baseUri.Fragment)) {
                errors.Add("ru-arg-base-url must not carry a query string or fragment");
            }
        }

        var results = parseRange("ru-arg-results", (string)context.Variables["ru-int-results-raw"], 1, 5000);
        var page = parseRange("ru-arg-page", (string)context.Variables["ru-int-page-raw"], 1, 1000);
        var minAge = parseRange("ru-arg-min-age", (string)context.Variables["ru-int-min-age-raw"], 0, 120);
        var maxAge = parseRange("ru-arg-max-age", (string)context.Variables["ru-int-max-age-raw"], 0, 120);
        var take = parseRange("ru-arg-take", (string)context.Variables["ru-int-take-raw"], 0, 5000);
        parseRange("ru-arg-timeout-seconds", (string)context.Variables["ru-int-timeout-raw"], 1, 30);
        var cache = parseRange("ru-arg-cache-seconds", (string)context.Variables["ru-int-cache-raw"], 0, 3600);

        if (minAge.HasValue && maxAge.HasValue && minAge.Value > maxAge.Value) {
            errors.Add($"ru-arg-min-age ({minAge}) must not exceed ru-arg-max-age ({maxAge})");
        }
        if (take.HasValue && results.HasValue && take.Value > results.Value) {
            errors.Add($"ru-arg-take ({take}) asks for more users than ru-arg-results ({results}) fetches");
        }

        // paging without a seed returns a fresh random set per page, which is never what anyone wants
        var seed = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-seed"];
        if (seed.Length > 0 && !Regex.IsMatch(seed, "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$")) {
            errors.Add("ru-arg-seed must match [A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}");
        }
        if (page.HasValue && page.Value > 1 && seed.Length == 0) {
            errors.Add("ru-arg-page > 1 needs ru-arg-seed, otherwise every page is a different population");
        }
        if (cache.HasValue && cache.Value > 0 && seed.Length == 0) {
            errors.Add("ru-arg-cache-seconds > 0 needs ru-arg-seed, unseeded responses are random and caching them lies");
        }

        var gender = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-gender"];
        if (gender != "" && gender != "male" && gender != "female") {
            errors.Add($"ru-arg-gender must be empty, \"male\" or \"female\", got \"{gender}\"");
        }

        var knownNats = new HashSet {
            "AU", "BR", "CA", "CH", "DE", "DK", "ES", "FI", "FR", "GB", "IE",
            "IN", "IR", "MX", "NL", "NO", "NZ", "RS", "TR", "UA", "US"
        };
        var nats = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-nationalities"];
        foreach (var nat in nats.Split(new[] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)) {
            if (!knownNats.Contains(nat)) {
                errors.Add($"ru-arg-nationalities contains unsupported code \"{nat}\"");
            }
        }

        var knownFields = new HashSet {
            "gender", "name", "location", "email", "login", "registered",
            "dob", "phone", "cell", "id", "picture", "nat"
        };
        var fields = ((string)context.Variables["ru-int-include-fields"])
            .Split(new[] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        foreach (var field in fields) {
            if (!knownFields.Contains(field)) {
                errors.Add($"ru-arg-include-fields contains unknown field \"{field}\"");
            }
        }

        // ru-arg-filter: which response field each User field comes from
        var sourceOf = new Dictionary {
            ["id"] = "login", ["email"] = "email", ["gender"] = "gender", ["nat"] = "nat",
            ["age"] = "dob", ["bornOn"] = "dob", ["displayName"] = "name", ["lastName"] = "name",
            ["city"] = "location", ["country"] = "location", ["timezone"] = "location", ["avatar"] = "picture"
        };
        var filterSources = new List();
        var filter = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-filter");
        if (filter != null) {
            var match = (string)filter["match"] ?? "all";
            if (match != "all" && match != "any") {
                errors.Add($"ru-arg-filter match must be all or any, got \"{match}\"");
            }
            var rules = filter["rules"] as JArray;
            if (rules == null) {
                errors.Add("ru-arg-filter rules must be an array of rules");
            } else {
                var index = 0;
                foreach (var token in rules) {
                    var rule = token as JObject;
                    var field = rule == null ? null : (string)rule["field"];
                    if (rule == null) {
                        errors.Add($"ru-arg-filter rules[{index}] must be an object");
                    } else if (field == null || !sourceOf.ContainsKey(field)) {
                        errors.Add($"ru-arg-filter rules[{index}] field must be a User field, got \"{field}\"");
                    } else {
                        filterSources.Add(sourceOf[field]);
                        if (rule["equals"] == null && rule["contains"] == null && rule["min"] == null && rule["max"] == null) {
                            errors.Add($"ru-arg-filter rules[{index}] needs equals, contains, min or max");
                        }
                        if ((rule["min"] != null || rule["max"] != null) && field != "age") {
                            errors.Add($"ru-arg-filter rules[{index}] can only use min and max on age");
                        }
                    }
                    index++;
                }
            }
        }

        // the post-processing below reads these, so they can't be projected away
        var sortBy = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-sort-by"];
        var needed = new List { "dob", "email", "nat", "gender" };
        if (sortBy == "last-name") { needed.Add("name"); }
        needed.AddRange(filterSources);
        if (fields.Length > 0) {
            foreach (var need in needed.Distinct().Where(n => !fields.Contains(n))) {
                errors.Add($"ru-arg-include-fields must include \"{need}\" for the summary values and filters");
            }
        }

        if (sortBy != "none" && sortBy != "age" && sortBy != "last-name" && sortBy != "email") {
            errors.Add($"ru-arg-sort-by must be none, age, last-name or email, got \"{sortBy}\"");
        }
        var direction = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-sort-direction"];
        if (direction != "asc" && direction != "desc") {
            errors.Add($"ru-arg-sort-direction must be asc or desc, got \"{direction}\"");
        }
        if (sortBy == "none" && direction == "desc") {
            errors.Add("ru-arg-sort-direction desc has no effect with ru-arg-sort-by none");
        }

        var failMode = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-fail-mode"];
        if (failMode != "soft" && failMode != "throw") {
            errors.Add($"ru-arg-fail-mode must be soft or throw, got \"{failMode}\"");
        }

        return errors;
    }" />

            <set-variable name="ru-int-query" value="@{
                var parts = new List<KeyValuePair> {
                    new KeyValuePair("results", (string)context.Variables["ru-int-results-raw"]),
                    new KeyValuePair("page", (string)context.Variables["ru-int-page-raw"]),
                    new KeyValuePair("format", "json"),
                    new KeyValuePair("noinfo", "")
                };
                var seed = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-seed"];
                if (seed != "") { parts.Add(new KeyValuePair("seed", seed)); }
                var gender = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-gender"];
                if (gender != "") { parts.Add(new KeyValuePair("gender", gender)); }
                var nats = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-nationalities"];
                if (nats != "") { parts.Add(new KeyValuePair("nat", nats.ToLowerInvariant())); }
                var fields = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-include-fields"];
                if (fields != "") { parts.Add(new KeyValuePair("inc", fields)); }

                // sorted so the cache key is stable regardless of argument order
                return string.Join("&", parts
                    .OrderBy(p => p.Key, StringComparer.Ordinal)
                    .Select(p => p.Value == "" ? Uri.EscapeDataString(p.Key) : $"{Uri.EscapeDataString(p.Key)}={Uri.EscapeDataString(p.Value)}"));
            }" />

                    <set-variable name="ru-int-projected" value="@{
                        var body = (JObject)context.Variables["ru-int-body"];
                        var minAge = int.Parse((string)context.Variables["ru-int-min-age-raw"]);
                        var maxAge = int.Parse((string)context.Variables["ru-int-max-age-raw"]);

                        return new JArray(((JArray)body["results"] ?? new JArray())
                            .OfType()
                            .Where(u => {
                                var age = (int?)u.SelectToken("dob.age") ?? -1;
                                return age >= minAge && age <= maxAge;
                            })
                            .Select(u => {
                                var projected = new JObject {
                                    ["id"] = (string)u.SelectToken("login.uuid") ?? Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                                    ["email"] = ((string)u["email"] ?? "").ToLowerInvariant(),
                                    ["gender"] = (string)u["gender"],
                                    ["nat"] = (string)u["nat"],
                                    ["age"] = (int?)u.SelectToken("dob.age"),
                                    ["bornOn"] = ((DateTime?)u.SelectToken("dob.date"))?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
                                };
                                if (u["name"] != null) {
                                    projected["displayName"] = string.Join(" ", new[] {
                                        (string)u.SelectToken("name.title"),
                                        (string)u.SelectToken("name.first"),
                                        (string)u.SelectToken("name.last")
                                    }.Where(s => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)));
                                    projected["lastName"] = (string)u.SelectToken("name.last");
                                }
                                if (u["location"] != null) {
                                    projected["city"] = (string)u.SelectToken("location.city");
                                    projected["country"] = (string)u.SelectToken("location.country");
                                    projected["timezone"] = (string)u.SelectToken("location.timezone.offset");
                                }
                                if (u["picture"] != null) {
                                    projected["avatar"] = (string)u.SelectToken("picture.thumbnail");
                                }
                                if (u["phone"] != null || u["cell"] != null) {
                                    projected["phones"] = new JArray(
                                        new[] { (string)u["phone"], (string)u["cell"] }
                                            .Where(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p))
                                            .Select(p => Regex.Replace(p, "[^0-9+]", ""))
                                            .Distinct()
                                    );
                                }
                                return projected;
                            }));
                    }" />
                    <set-variable name="ru-int-kept" value="@{
                        // ru-arg-filter: every rule must pass ("all"), or one of them ("any")
                        var users = ((JArray)context.Variables["ru-int-projected"]).OfType();
                        var filter = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ru-arg-filter");
                        var rules = ((filter?["rules"] as JArray) ?? new JArray()).OfType().ToList();
                        var matchAny = (string)filter?["match"] == "any";
                        bool passes(JObject user, JObject rule) {
                            var value = user[(string)rule["field"]];
                            if (rule["equals"] != null && !string.Equals((string)value, (string)rule["equals"], StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return false; }
                            if (rule["contains"] != null && ((string)value ?? "").IndexOf((string)rule["contains"], StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) < 0) { return false; }
                            if (rule["min"] != null && ((int?)value ?? int.MinValue) < (int)rule["min"]) { return false; }
                            if (rule["max"] != null && ((int?)value ?? int.MaxValue) > (int)rule["max"]) { return false; }
                            return true;
                        }
                        return new JArray(rules.Count == 0 ? users : users.Where(u => matchAny ? rules.Any(r => passes(u, r)) : rules.All(r => passes(u, r))));
                    }" />
                    
                    <set-variable name="ru-ret-users" value="@{
                        var users = ((JArray)context.Variables["ru-int-kept"]).OfType();
                        var sortBy = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-sort-by"];
                        var descending = (string)context.Variables["ru-int-sort-direction"] == "desc";
                        var take = int.Parse((string)context.Variables["ru-int-take-raw"]);

                        // one OrderBy per key, so the selector's type (Func<>, IComparable) is never named
                        switch (sortBy) {
                            case "age":
                                users = descending ? users.OrderByDescending(u => (int?)u["age"] ?? 0) : users.OrderBy(u => (int?)u["age"] ?? 0);
                                break;
                            case "last-name":
                                users = descending ? users.OrderByDescending(u => ((string)u["lastName"] ?? "").ToLowerInvariant()) : users.OrderBy(u => ((string)u["lastName"] ?? "").ToLowerInvariant());
                                break;
                            case "email":
                                users = descending ? users.OrderByDescending(u => (string)u["email"] ?? "") : users.OrderBy(u => (string)u["email"] ?? "");
                                break;
                        }
                        if (take > 0) {
                            users = users.Take(take);
                        }
                        return new JArray(users);
                    }" />
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    <set-variable name="ru-ret-nationality-histogram" value="@{
                        // counted by hand: GroupBy's IGrouping isn't on the gateway allowlist
                        var counts = new Dictionary();
                        foreach (var u in (JArray)context.Variables["ru-ret-users"]) {
                            var nat = (string)u["nat"] ?? "??";
                            int seen;
                            counts.TryGetValue(nat, out seen);
                            counts[nat] = seen + 1;
                        }
                        var histogram = new JObject();
                        foreach (var pair in counts.OrderByDescending(p => p.Value).ThenBy(p => p.Key)) {
                            histogram[pair.Key] = pair.Value;
                        }
                        return histogram;
                    }" />
